data.question: Which employees on my team have Python skills?
data.sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees AS e JOIN employee_skills AS es ON es.employee_id = e.id JOIN skills AS s ON s.id = es.skill_id WHERE e.manager_id = :current_employee_id AND es.employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM employees WHERE manager_id = :current_employee_id) LIMIT 100
data.summary: The query returned one matching record.
